card.name: Information literacy and academic skills text
card.fires_on: Words inside academic or library text about information literacy, research skills and citing sources, often adjectives or small linking words such as critically, the, all, of and to. It fires mid-phrase, before a skill or object.

modes.label: Skill phrases
modes.description: Adjectives or verbs in lists of research skills, just before words like evaluate or efficient.
modes.example: the ability to find,<< critically>> evaluate

modes.label: Linking words in definitions
modes.description: Small words such as the, all or of inside definitions of information use.
modes.example: the techniques and skills for utilizing<< the>> wide range of information tools

modes.label: Teaching and writing guidance
modes.description: Nouns or adjectives in guidance on writing questions or reading papers.
modes.example: Have all distractors (and the correct answer) about the same<< length>>.

card.plain: It marks library and teaching text on research skills, such as finding, judging and citing information.
